svg.title: How pid-rs turns rows into atoms, and where it refuses
svg.desc: Categorical, binned and continuous routes through pid-rs, from input declaration and budget checks to the returned atoms, and the typed errors returned instead of an estimate.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: HOW pid-rs TURNS ROWS INTO ATOMS, AND WHERE IT REFUSES
SHARED EXCLUSIONS, WIBRAL LINE: SIGNED ATOMS IN NATS
The stable report ksg_mi_report stops at one mutual information; it gives no atoms.
OTHER MEASURE, DIFFERENT AXIOMS: COMPARISON ONLY
another redundancy measure on the same lattice, with other axioms
A refusal is a typed error returned before any estimate, never a guess:
exact ties, a zero radius or an ambiguous neighbor shell
The user's declaration selects the route; a passed check does not prove the declaration true.
Call routes of pid-core at 3bed167; a schematic of the code paths, not a validation result.
More than four categorical sources is refused as not implemented. Every refusal is a PidError value.
